item.caduceus.desc: Solidifies liquid metal into a random weapon on every attack.
prescript.stagger_one: Attack an enemy until it staggers
prescript.reap: Cut an enemy with the scythe
prescript.lash: Lash an enemy with the whip
prescript.pierce: Run an enemy through with the lance
prescript.sink_twice: Stab an enemy %s times with the stiletto
prescript.untouched: Strike an enemy %s times without taking damage
command.usage: Usage: /indexprescript give <caduceus|terminal|laevatein|hammer|blackgod> [player], /indexprescript laevatein <0-3>, /indexprescript pack, /indexprescript sanity [value], /indexprescript mang [1-6], /indexprescript blackgod, /indexprescript anim <name|list|reload|stop>, /indexprescript fx <name|list|reload>, /indexprescript skills reload
resource_pack.prompt: This pack shows Caduceus and the terminal.
command.laevatein_usage: Hold Laevatein and use /indexprescript laevatein <0-3> (0: sealed, 1-3: release stage)
command.laevatein_status: Laevatein - stage: %s, hits: %s, icon count: %s, ready: %s
item.mimicry.desc: Gebura's E.G.O. Right-click: choose a skill · F: manifest E.G.O (Sanity 40+, health 50% or less)
command.mang_on: Winding %s Mang ring(s) for 15 seconds (Strength). Run again without a number to end it.
renoir.again: Strike Again and Again, Sever Birth!
renoir.no_target: No enemy where you are looking.
renoir.need_voice: Needs at least 50 Black God's Voice (now %s).
blackgod.item.desc: Right-click: become the Black God (your inventory is kept and comes back when you leave)
blackgod.use.desc: Right-click: lay the skills along the hotbar; a number key (hotbar slot) uses one
blackgod.leave.desc: Right-click: turn back and get your inventory back
blackgod.title: Black God
blackgod.on: Inventory kept. 'Leave Black God' turns you back.
blackgod.off: Left Black God mode. Inventory returned.
blackgod.choose: Pick a skill with a number key (1-9); right-click uses the one in hand.
blackgod.revive: The Black God refuses death. (%s revival(s) left)
blackgod.cooldown: This skill is ready again in %s s.
blackgod.to_authority: The Black God's Voice became the Authority.
blackgod.to_voice: The Black God's Authority became the Voice again.
blackgod.got_stop: This turn you hold [Stop]. (+25% damage to the Black God)
blackgod.got_pulse: This turn you hold [Pulse]. (-50% damage from the Black God)
blackgod.bride_steps_in: The Bride stepped into the system: health and ailments restored.
blackgod.shield: Time to clock out. System Preservation became a shield.
blackgod.need_authority: This skill needs the Black God's Authority.
